vision: REL37.07 Data EN UI Org adopts an enterprise data strategy that links NDMO governance and PDPL compliance to catalog, quality, and lifecycle control. The strategy makes data assets discoverable and accountable.
environment_narrative:
REL37.07 Data EN UI Org operates under national data-governance expectations from NDMO and personal-data duties from PDPL, with rising pressure on catalog coverage, quality, consent, and data-subject rights.

Operating drivers include classification completeness, lifecycle control, documented sharing, and on-time incident notification inside the data scope.
